Metadata.title: TrusTrove | Decentralized Trade Finance Operations Terminal
Metadata.description: Tokenize unpaid trade invoices as Stellar assets and receive immediate USDC funding. Yield opportunities for liquidity providers.

welcome.title: Welcome to TrusTrove
welcome.body: Your wallet is connected. This quick tour shows where everything lives. Press Escape at any time to leave it.

role.title: Pick your role
role.body: SMEs (issuers) tokenize unpaid invoices, buyers confirm and repay them, and LPs (funders) supply USDC liquidity. Switch roles here; the app adapts its actions to match.

balances.title: Your wallet balances
balances.body: Live USDC and XLM balances for the connected Freighter wallet. XLM pays network fees; USDC is what invoices are funded and repaid in.

dashboard.title: SME Dashboard
dashboard.body: Issuers create invoices, track funding and repayments, and work through the Get Started checklist here.

lp.title: LP Portal
lp.body: Liquidity providers deposit USDC into the pool, watch yield accrue, and withdraw their share.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Browse invoices listed for funding, with their discount, due date and issuer status.

profile.title: Profile & verification
profile.body: Verification registers your business in the on-chain TrusTrove Registry. Verified wallets unlock invoice creation, trading and funding.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Relaunch this tour any time from the Take the tour button in the navigation bar.
